name: Issue 3563: Wind Surge's chain-target modifier on Weapon Engraving: Air is wired and native
contract: Wind Surge 805750 promises two additional enemies for Weapon Engraving: Air. Its native flat
SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS modifier has base points 2, die sides 1 and class mask (0, 0x40000, 0), yielding three
Air copy damage inherits the resolved source amount and ignores caster amount modifiers. The exact Wind Surge
target modifier must still apply through ordinary family, mask and script checks; disabling amount modifiers
must not remove the two additional targets.
Alternate helper 653257 carries the same family mask but ignores caster modifiers without the Wind Surge
exemption, so its target modifier remains zero. Native enchant activation and actual chained copy damage are
covered by the Air Engraving 6003 regressions.

steps.label: SETUP: no chain-target bonus on Weapon Engraving: Air before learning Wind Surge
